[a11y label walkthrough]: This is a step-by-step walkthrough. It guides you through a process one step at a time. Press Tab to move between buttons and clickable areas on the screen, then press Enter or Space to activate the focused step and move to the next one. Some steps show information you can read and then continue; others show an image with clickable areas — focus an area and press Enter to advance. On small screens, open the walkthrough in full screen first; press Escape to exit full screen at any time.
[a11y label scenario]: This is a branching scenario that simulates a real situation. They are made up of multiple scenes. Each scene is either a piece of information, or a dialogue with choices. Press Tab to move between the scene text and the available choices, then press Enter or Space to select a choice. Your selection moves you to the next scene, which may show information to read, more choices, or the end of the scenario. Use the back control to revisit your previous scene, or restart to begin again from the start. On small screens, open the scenario in full screen first; press Escape to exit full screen at any time.
[a11y label checklist]: This is a checklist you can use to track your own progress while you read. Press Tab to move between items, then press Space or Enter to tick or untick the focused item. The progress bar at the top updates each time you change a tick. Your progress is kept only for this session — if you reload or come back later, the checklist will be empty again.
[a11y label card sorting]: This is a card-sorting activity. You will see a stack of cards and a row of categories. Your task is to place each card into the category it belongs to. Press Tab to focus the card on top of the stack, then press the Right or Left arrow key to look through the other cards in the stack. Press Enter or Space to pick up the focused card; the categories then become reachable. Press Tab to move between categories and press Enter or Space on a category to drop the card there. After each drop you will hear "Correct" or "Incorrect" — a correct card is removed from the stack and you continue with the next one. Keep going until the stack is empty, or use the restart control to begin again.
[a11y label how to]: This is a how-to guide that explains a task in steps. On larger screens the steps appear as a list of tabs: press Tab to focus the list, then use the Up and Down arrow keys to move between steps, and press Enter or Space to open the focused step. On smaller screens each step appears as an expandable row: press Tab to focus a step, then press Enter or Space to open or close it. There is no scoring or submission — read through the steps in any order you prefer.
[a11y label hotspot on image]: This image contains several clickable hotspots that reveal extra information. Press Tab to move between the hotspots, then press Enter or Space on a focused hotspot to open its popup. The popup may contain text and images. Press Escape, or activate the same hotspot again, to close the popup. You can visit the hotspots in any order, and you do not need to open all of them to continue.
[a11y label flip cards]: This is a set of flip cards. Each card shows information on the front and additional information on the back. Press Tab to focus a card, then press Enter or Space to flip it and reveal the other side. Press Enter or Space again to flip back. You can flip the cards in any order, and you do not need to flip all of them to continue.
[a11y label show more]: This block hides extra information until you ask to see it. Press Tab to focus the heading, then press Enter or Space to expand the block and reveal its content. Press Enter or Space again to collapse it. The hidden content may include text, images, or other content blocks.
[a11y label carousel]: This is an image carousel that shows one slide at a time. Press Tab to focus the previous-slide and next-slide buttons, then press Enter or Space to move to the previous or next slide. With a slide button focused you can also press the Left or Right arrow key to change slides without moving focus. Each time the slide changes you will hear its position, such as \"Slide 3 of 5\", along with the image description. Each slide may show an image or other content. You can view the slides in any order, and you do not need to view all of them to continue.
